mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is kept on in all builds, with no exception for development builds. The project also enforces HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception even for internal services.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says that TLS certificate verification stays on in all builds, with no exception for development builds.

Two recorded decisions shaped the paragraph:
- **#35:** "Keep verification on all builds, no exceptions for development." It is the current TLS-verification decision.
- **#38:** "Enforce HTTPS everywhere, no plaintext exception even for internal services." I added this as a second sentence. It is a separate decision from #35, so drop it if you want the file to cover verification only.

The earlier proposal to allow plain HTTP for internal hosts (#36) was overridden by #38, and the older decision to disable verification in dev builds was replaced by #35. I left both out of the document.

The first attempt to write the file through a shell command failed with a parser error. I wrote it again with the Write tool and did not read it back.
